correctness.rationale: The proof classifies all closed factors according to whether they are constant, have a constant longest border, or have a mixed-letter longest border. Unique cyclic boundary phases force the mixed border to return after one period. The unary-frontier case forces symmetric same-letter endpoint fragments across adjacent cycles. Counting allowed starting phases and excluded constant prefixes proves both the complete length spectrum and total. A literal, independent finite enumeration of 4,032 parameter cases compared exact factor sets, length histograms, and formula. The proof, not enumeration, establishes all positive parameters.

value.rationale: Closed-factor complexity is a standard first-return/string-index invariant. Exact spectra for a full multi-parameter family of repetitive run-encoded words determine every factor length and show a non-obvious collapse to period length and run-length second moment; the exact increment of p² per additional repetition is a structural law. This is a motivated complete classification and exact invariant, not a numerical slice or generic bound restatement.
